title: Silas and the Protocol
author: Jude Ravensworth
blurb: Edmund Underhill, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
